title: FileReadCompleted
description: Result: a file under watch_dir was read successfully, in reply to a FileReadRequested (Design.md §13 Step F2). eventDetails.correlationId is set to that request's eventId. If the file doesn't exist, FileOperationFailed is published instead — not this event.

path.description: File path, relative to watch_dir, that was read.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the file's content in bytes.

occurredAt.description: UTC timestamp (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601) the read completed.
